name: hover-marquee
title: 浮入滚动目录 Hover Marquee
description: 目录行浮入或聚焦后，显示无缝横向滚动的内容预览。

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown while the row is idle.

props.name: marquee
props.description: Content repeated inside the moving preview track.

props.name: speed
props.description: Track speed in pixels per second.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between repeated preview items in pixels.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Move the preview track in the opposite direction.

props.name: active
props.description: Force the preview open from outside the component.

props.name: marqueeClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the moving preview layer.

usage:
`HoverMarquee` 默认展示普通目录行，鼠标浮入或键盘焦点进入时，以横向循环的预览带替换原内容。它适合作品索引、案例目录、分类导航和视觉化菜单。

组件内部复用 `InfiniteSlider`，安装时会自动带上对应依赖。启用“减少动态效果”时仍会显示预览内容，但不会持续滚动。
